title: Mail Scoring: audit reusable TypeScript scanners and establish bounded v1 contract
body:
Repository to change: https://github.com/crumrine/mail-scoring. Parent DEV-874. Start from its current main/bootstrap, not the Agentic Inbox repository.

Problem: a close existing MIT TypeScript candidate (@sarv-in/mailguard) may meet most offline-scoring needs. Establish the smallest safe reuse path before reimplementing it. This ticket must leave an executable foundation, not a research-only recommendation.

Implementation
1. Audit pinned Mailguard candidate ae51a1ddee18649ef729a4195313cbf57db22e87 (package 0.4.3), package tarball/export graph, MIT notices, transitive/data licenses and lifecycle scripts. Compare narrow imports versus attributed adaptation versus original minimal core. Research references and exact revisions for OhMyMsg, SpamScanner and Postal Mime are in docs/research.md. Do not copy BUSL-labelled/unclear derived code, weights or corpora without resolved exact-version provenance; no assumption based on a root license or expired change-date alone.
2. Create reproducible Node24/npm-locked TypeScript tooling, CI and portable core/Worker-spike layout (prefer packages/core, workers/scorer, fixtures, scripts). Freeze ScoreInputV1/ScoreResultV1 schemas and protocol docs, including rule-set version, finite heuristic score, spam/phishing/marketing signals, complete/partial/unavailable and bounded static reason IDs. A score is not a calibrated probability.
3. Core takes bounded structured fields, not raw MIME or attachment bytes. Implement reusable byte/cardinality/field guards with the SECURITY.md ceilings (256KiB request, 128KiB combined source text, 64KiB decoded extracted text, 32KiB headers, 100 headers, 8KiB/header, 100 URLs, 32 filename/type metadata entries) and explicit truncation/incomplete semantics. Do not turn inspection limits into delivery rejection limits.
4. Bundle and execute the minimum selected narrow modules through real workerd with fetch/DNS/native/attachment features unavailable. Inspect emitted imports and initialization; no umbrella import that drags forbidden features in. If no candidate is safe/compatible, document failures and choose minimal original primitives within the same scope. No need to ask Brian about routine library choices.
5. Commit adoption decision, dependency/data provenance and third-party notices, exact lock/SBOM and synthetic hostile fixtures. Preserve original MIT notices for any adapted code.

Acceptance
- A fresh npm ci and documented typecheck/test/workerd-spike commands pass in CI; locked dependencies and licenses recorded.
- Actual selected module path executes in workerd and cannot fetch/DNS/read files/inspect attachment bytes, including initialization.
- Guards cover malformed/oversize/duplicate headers, multibyte lengths, control chars and unknown auth provenance; no message content appears in errors or logs.
- Decision compares bundle size and limitations and demonstrates that tests catch a removed bound/network guard. Leave a concrete contract and stable package exports for the next ticket.

title: Mail Scoring: implement deterministic explainable rules with bounded inert text inspection
body:
Repository to change: https://github.com/crumrine/mail-scoring. Parent DEV-874. Depends on the reviewed reuse/contract PR; pin its head before implementation.

Implement the portable v0.1 scoring core according to the adoption decision. Prefer selected audited narrow library modules; do not build equivalent machinery merely because this is a new project.

Scope
- Inert bounded HTML/text normalization and lexical URL comparisons; no DOM renderer, URL navigation/fetch or attachments. Cap HTML nesting, tags, decoded output, URL count/length/decoding and all expensive work. Avoid catastrophic regex. Inspection that hits a bound remains partial.
- Named deterministic rules and contribution caps for deceptive visible-link targets, identity/reply-to anomalies, impersonation patterns, suspicious combined content/header evidence and explicit supplied preference facts. Correlated signals cannot amplify without bounds. Unknown auth remains neutral/unknown; verified auth pass alone never means wanted; common freemail/new sender, non-English text, ordinary newsletter/unsubscribe or urgency alone must not trigger high-spam classification.
- Maintain independent spam/phishing/marketing evidence. Inputs cannot supply dynamic regex, code, trusted rule weights or auth assertions without provenance. Match Message-ID/References or subject only for context, never automatic trust. An address-only allow preference must not erase established spoofing evidence.
- Output finite bounded score, static safe reasons/contributions, versions and completeness according to v1 schema; no raw attacker strings/URLs echoed. Inject receive time for deterministic tests. Scoring does not move/reject/delete/train/send mail or store content.

Acceptance
- Synthetic fixtures for legitimate new contact, newsletter, receipt, forwarded/replied mail, multilingual/Unicode, quoted harmful content, misleading links, forged auth/reply chain and prompt instructions. Marketing-only is distinguishable from spam.
- Same input/time/policy produces same result; missing/truncated analysis cannot report fully inspected safe. Contributions and schema are validated, with no content-bearing logs.
- Property/adversarial tests demonstrate bounded work on repeated tags/tokens/encoded URLs/huge attributes at the declared ceilings, and fail when guards are removed.
- Zero runtime network/DNS/native/dynamic-code activity and no attachment inspection. Include actual workerd tests and initial cold/warm bundle/performance samples with environment and limits; no unmeasured efficacy claim.

title: Mail Scoring: expose a private Cloudflare scoring Worker with strict resource and privacy boundaries
body:
Repository to change: https://github.com/crumrine/mail-scoring. Parent DEV-874. Depends on the reviewed deterministic-core PR; use its recorded head.

Build a thin Cloudflare WorkerEntrypoint RPC adapter over score(input), suitable for a private service binding from Agentic Inbox and other same-account Workers. The portable library remains usable separately.

Implementation
- Versioned RPC interface and consumer fixture matching ScoreInputV1/ScoreResultV1. Enforce serialized-size and nested-field limits before expensive work; reject unsupported versions and invalid schema through a safe typed response. The caller maps service failure to preserved delivery. RPC validation cannot rely on client types.
- Wrangler configuration has no public routes/custom domain, workers.dev disabled and preview public URLs disabled. No R2/mailbox DO/database/send_email/AI/network service credentials or other privileged binding. No public HTTP scoring endpoint. A harmless non-RPC handler may return 404.
- No outbound fetch/DNS/url checking, async background scanner or content retention. Bounded aggregate metrics only: rule/version/status/limits/timing buckets without raw email/sender/subject/URLs/stable mail IDs. Sanitize third-party exceptions.
- Bound synchronous processing at core level; do not advertise Promise.race as CPU cancellation. Supply local multi-Worker consumer/scorer configuration and disabled-by-default integration sample, without real secrets/account IDs.
- Add CI build/dry-run bundle checks, dependency license/SBOM artifact, executable local workerd boundary tests, and a documented release/rollback configuration. No provider deployment or npm publish.

Acceptance
- Actual consumer Worker invokes scorer by service binding locally; valid, malformed, oversize, multibyte, version mismatch and partial results exercised.
- Config/bundle tests prove no public exposure, no unintended bindings/network/native/attachment imports and no message content in logs/errors. Tests catch a deliberately introduced fetch or resource leak.
- Benchmark representative bounded benign/hostile fixtures cold/warm with median/p95/max and bundle size. Proposed ordinary-fixture p95 target below 25ms wall in stated local environment; disclose misses/host overhead, do not claim billed CPU or zero compute cost.
- Contract and sample are sufficient for Inbox integration without giving the scorer mailbox privileges.

title: Agentic Inbox: persist shadow spam assessments and explicit mailbox feedback through Mail Scoring
body:
Repository to change: https://github.com/crumrine/agentic-inbox-imap (local context /Users/brian/projects/agentic-inbox). Scorer contract dependency: https://github.com/crumrine/mail-scoring reviewed private-Worker PR. Parent DEV-874. Inspect actual current main and existing changes/PRs before editing; do not resurrect old unmerged performance work.

Add opt-in off/shadow scoring at inbound intake, with no automatic quarantine yet. Read existing CLAUDE.md/CONTRIBUTING.md; no commit may touch both gateway/ and Worker source.

Scope
- workers/app.ts email entrypoint and workers/index.ts receiveEmail pass minimal bounded already-parsed fields and available transport evidence to a private scorer binding, after valid mailbox/alias resolution. No raw MIME/attachment bytes/credentials or extra MIME parse in the scorer. Bound raw inspection before expensive extraction where possible; accurately document inherited parser limits rather than claiming parser safety from an after-the-fact cap.
- Preserve current mail acceptance/routing, raw-byte MIME storage, attachments, UID allocation and manual drafting. Scorer unavailable/invalid/partial/timeout keeps normal delivery and stores an incomplete status. Off mode makes zero scorer calls. Shadow mode stores assessment but leaves folder placement alone. Score once per arrival; normal 30s UI/IMAP refresh makes zero calls. Any explicit re-evaluation is versioned and bounded, not a historical backfill.
- Append DO migration and keep Drizzle/schema/create paths/types aligned. Store assessment versions, rule contributions/completeness and explicit manual disposition without duplicating body data. Existing rows are unknown/unscored. Use transactionSync not SQL BEGIN. Preserve original assessment when feedback overrides disposition.
- Add authenticated mailbox-scoped mark-spam/not-spam and separate always-allow/block preference business functions in shared workers/lib/tools.ts with REST wrappers as needed. A routine move/delete/rescue does not automatically train or create an allow rule. Agent/email text cannot authorize persistent preference updates. Do not create a cross-tenant reputation store. Protect concurrent updates and invalid IDs.
- Add an evidence report documenting Cloudflare auth-result availability/provenance as unknown until live intake is authorized. Only trusted explicitly established transport data contributes auth evidence; duplicate/spoofed Authentication-Results/ARC/x-spam headers are not trusted by name or claimed authserv-id. Do not redo DNS authentication or IP blocklists.

Acceptance
- Actual REST/inbound local workerd path with synthetic mailbox/R2, mock scorer and real DO SQLite proves off/shadow behavior, alias/Bcc/multi-recipient routing preservation, persistence/migration and no poll rescoring.
- Scorer failure/malformed output/oversized or truncated input never drops or rejects legitimate received mail, mutates preferences or starts AI. Idempotent feedback behavior tested.
- Focused suites, npm run typecheck, npm test and any touched Go checks per repo instructions; tests with remoteBindings:false/fake send_email only. No outbound email or private-data capture.

title: Agentic Inbox: add recoverable Spam controls and isolate quarantine across threads, search and agent context
body:
Repository to change: https://github.com/crumrine/agentic-inbox-imap. Parent DEV-874. Depends on reviewed shadow-assessment/feedback PR; branch from that exact head. Use the existing folder and UID model; no second mailbox store.

Problem: Spam exists in migrations/shared/folders.ts but is not a first-class system link/tool description. Thread readers and conversation statistics currently aggregate across folders, so moving mail alone can leak spam back into normal views and agent context.

Scope
- First-class Spam folder, bounded safe score/reason/completeness display, explicit Spam/Not spam/rescue controls and separate allow/block preference controls using shared APIs. Explain heuristic scores without percentage-confidence claims. Escape all reasons/metadata; suspicious previews never automatically fetch tracking images, active content, styles or links.
- App policy can support off/shadow/quarantine modes, but delivered default remains off/shadow with quarantine disabled. Thresholds configurable and conservative, without claiming calibration. Unknown/partial inspection cannot silently auto-quarantine. No spam-based SMTP rejection/delete or auto-replies.
- Quarantine excludes messages from normal thread content, participants, unread/needs-reply/has-draft aggregates, notifications, default search and agent/MCP retrieval/context. Explicit Spam views/search allow review. Inspect all callers, not only the SPA. Forged references/subject/thread ID must not inject quarantined content into a trusted conversation. Normal non-Spam semantics otherwise preserved.
- IMAP Spam/Junk visibility and existing SPECIAL-USE must remain usable; moves/rescue allocate new destination UIDs with existing rules and do not renumber old folders. Client MOVE-to-Spam remains ordinary move unless an explicit feedback action was made; do not infer new training semantics. If Go changes are needed, separate gateway-only commits from Worker commits.

Acceptance
- Synthetic thread crossing inbox/sent/spam, malicious reply-chain/subject collision, rescue, mark read, feedback overrides and alternate-client moves tested through actual handlers and shared tool surfaces.
- Safe UI verification (desktop/mobile) confirms recoverable Spam and escaped reasons; fixtures containing hostile HTML/images cannot execute/fetch in a suspicious preview.
- All regular aggregate/context paths exclude quarantine; explicit Spam review retrieves it. Migration/legacy rows and off/shadow behavior preserved.
- Run applicable npm/typecheck/full tests and Go checks if touched; no live mail, production configuration or deployment. Exact PR head, prerequisite pins and remaining live device tests recorded.

Pin exact heads of both repositories and assemble their reviewed source without merging/pushing into another worker's branches.

Produce an independent source-level release-readiness assessment and reproducible synthetic multi-Worker/inbox harness. This ticket does not deploy or activate filtering and does not require private mail to finish.

Checks
- Exercise actual local workerd email-entry/inbound persistence/scorer private binding/DO/page-and-thread/feedback/rescue flows. Fake send_email and remoteBindings:false; prohibit real email, paid AI, link/DNS requests and content logging.
- Adversarial corpus: oversized/malformed/deep structures, duplicate/spoofed auth results, forged thread references, control/bidi/Unicode, huge tokens/attributes/encoded URLs, HTML script/form/image payloads and embedded prompt instructions. Include ordinary newsletters, receipts, new contacts, forwarded/replied and multilingual messages. No attachment bytes or execution. Document generated fixture provenance and redistribution rights.

Verify log/error/output sanitization, confidentiality and cross-mailbox feedback isolation. Record any inherited MIME parser exposure honestly.

Assess deterministic classification on synthetic labels with false-positive/miss counts and clearly limited scope; no production accuracy, savings or hosted CPU claim.
